item.title: Fix off-by-one in sliding_windows so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request: in this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in window.py so every test passes, without changing the tests (test_window.py must stay untouched), and make the function correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit the fix on the local branch.

Known cause: sliding_windows(items, size) in window.py returns `[items[i : i + size] for i in range(len(items) - size)]`, which drops the final window and returns [] when len(items) == size. The range stop must be len(items) - size + 1. Keep the existing ValueError for size <= 0. Confirm the edge cases by reasoning: size > len(items) must return [] (range becomes empty, which is correct), empty items with size >= 1 must return [], and size == len(items) must return one window. Keep the function short and the comment-free style of the file. Run `python3 -m unittest` and confirm all tests pass before committing. Commit with the author's own git identity only, with no tool or AI attribution in the message.

state.summary:

Committed 77b19e6 on archon/v0tjdv3g-fix-off-by-one-in-sliding-windows-so-pyt under the configured identity (mengsig); no tests changed, no push. Checks: `python3 -m unittest` before: 2 failures (test_includes_the_last_window, test_whole_list_is_one_window); after: 3 tests, OK. pr.body: Approach: one-line change to the range stop in sliding_windows in window.py, len(items) - size + 1. Empty range still covers size > len(items) and empty input. ValueError for size <= 0 kept. Files: window.py only. Tests: test_window.py unchanged; python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 (was 2 failures). Edge cases checked as listed in checks. Reviewer agt_01M7W8JS8G6YD7Y3BWREY5C4GA also compared against a reference comprehension for lengths 0-7 and sizes 1-9 with no mismatches. Assumptions: none beyond the existing test expectations.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return the final window. now size == len(items) yields one window. before: range stop len-size dropped last window and gave [] for full-length windows; now: len-size+1.
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window

risk.why: One-line range-bound change in an isolated function, no API or behaviour change for valid inputs beyond the fix. Tests pass before/after; reviewer confirmed with exhaustive comparison; risk low.
